title: Multimodal Resource-Exhaustion Attacks on Vision-Language Models via Joint Pixel-Prompt Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.05889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Resource-exhaustion attacks against autoregressive vision-language models (VLMs) typically assume unimodal threat models, treating the image branch as the primary optimization surface while holding user-visible prompts fixed. Even recent loop-centric variants remain confined to this single-channel paradigm, leaving the exploitation of availability unexplored as a cross-modal optimization problem over jointly controllable input surfaces.   We introduce Joint Pixel-Prompt Optimization (JPPO), the first compound adversarial framework elevating the visible prompt to a first-class adversarial variable alongside image perturbations. Under a restricted joint-input threat model, JPPO performs coupled, stagewise optimization over both the pixel and prompt surfaces. translated_title: 通过联合像素-提示优化对视觉-语言模型的多模态资源耗尽攻击
translated_abstract: 针对自回归视觉-语言模型（VLM）的资源耗尽攻击通常假设单模态威胁模型，将图像分支视为主要优化表面，同时保持用户可见提示固定不变。即使近期以循环为中心的变体仍然局限于这种单通道范式，使得可用性攻击作为跨模态优化问题在联合可控输入表面上尚未被探索。我们提出了联合像素-提示优化（JPPO），这是首个将可见提示与图像扰动一起提升为第一等对抗变量的复合对抗框架。在受限的联合输入威胁模型下，JPPO在像素和提示两个表面上执行耦合的分阶段优化。这产生了协同的成本放大效应，在机制上区别于依赖循环的故障，且在我们的实验中表现出可忽略不计的循环发生率。通过评估五个开源……
tldr: 提出首个联合优化图像扰动与用户可见提示的复合对抗框架JPPO，通过对视觉-语言模型的跨模态联合输入优化实现协同放大的资源耗尽攻击，其机制独立于传统依赖循环的攻击方式。
en_tdlr: JPPO, the first compound adversarial framework jointly optimizing image perturbations and user-visible prompts, enables synergistic cost amplification in resource-exhaustion attacks on vision-language models through cross-modal optimization, mechanistically distinct from loop-dependent failures.
